Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The original six findings are now partly addressed: RealAdmission.inventoryColumns translates participant/phase/trial/item/occurrence and response/attributes through TrialInventoryColumns in shared code, so item (6) is implemented. ColumnMappingPaneHost provides the actual Data remap/re-admit path. This does not establish every inventory UX/role agreement/wire/fake case in the ticket. Review those individually rather than treating S3.7 planning prose as proof that translation is absent.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/real/RealAdmission.scala:182
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/importing/ColumnMappingPaneHost.scala:42
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/importing/InventorySource.scala:1

Remaining / next action: Verify/wire the InventorySourceVM admission counts in the Data view and record board parity; enforce cross-file identity-role agreement in DatasetRevisionSpec; cover missing phase/drop-source remap UX, null-versus-omitted command inventory encoding and fake Undeclared/InventoryRefused scenarios. Retain the existing shared native column translation.

Disposition: Keep open.
